acceptance_predicates.description: Guided TUI-facing commands and screens remain human-readable and selectable by default.
Supported machine output uses stable --json or existing --format json selectors and compatibility aliases.
Unknown, malformed, unavailable-channel, and credential-free paths provide typed actionable diagnostics without secret leakage.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes focused and hosted checks.
Independent review verifies guided defaults, selectors, diagnostics, and redaction.
Exact-main post-merge receipt records the protected head and trusted checks.

inputs.description: TUI setup, benchmark, recording, replay, comparison, lifecycle, and channel flows.

outputs.description: Selectable human defaults, stable machine selectors, typed failures, command/screen matrix, and credential-free transcript.

gates.description: PR and exact-main checks pass on merged head.
